prompt:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
MASTER ART DIRECTION v4 — ALL 21 SECTIONS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. CURRENT GAME IDENTITY
MYTHOS GATES: ASCENSION. Mythology-driven extradimensional fantasy RPG. 7 factions × 4 gods/goddesses (2 male + 2 female) = 28 playable divine characters. Do not alter roster structure unless Codex changes.

2. THE GODS ARE THE HEROES
Every playable character is an actual god or goddess — NOT mortals, soldiers, humans who became gods, generic champions, Titan creatures, aliens, sci-fi beings, or superheroes. Goal: "This is an actual god who has entered the battlefield."

3. THE FIVE CORE DESIGN LAYERS
GOD/GODDESS IDENTITY — Who is this specific deity?
MYTHOLOGY — What mythological identity inspires them?
FACTION — What divine civilization do they belong to?
REALM — What realm shaped their existence and culture?
MYTHOS GATES — How are they connected to the extradimensional Gates?
These combine into one coherent character. Do not design mythology first and add faction armor afterward. Do not design a generic god and recolor for realm.

4. REALM LORE IS MANDATORY
Read Codex and identify realm history, environment, architecture, culture, spirituality, mythology, materials, clothing, weapons, symbols, magic, creatures, atmosphere, and Gate relationship. Incorporate directly into character's armor, clothing, jewelry, weapon, crown/headpiece, hairstyles, divine markings, materials, artifacts, energy, symbols, silhouette, magical effects. The god must look like they belong to that realm — NOT just placed in front of a realm-themed background.

5. FACTION IDENTITY
Each of 7 factions must have strong, immediately recognizable visual identity. Architecture, materials, divine symbols, clothing, armor, weapons, jewelry, magical effects, color language, ritual markings, cultural motifs, creature symbolism. Do not make all factions look like variations of the same civilization. Use Codex as source of truth. Do not invent replacement factions. Do not merge factions.

6. MYTHOLOGY MUST REMAIN RECOGNIZABLE
Each god/goddess retains recognizable mythological identity elements: traditional symbolism, divine domains, legendary weapons, mythological creatures, historical iconography, cultural clothing, sacred objects, mythological stories, personality traits. Reinterpret into Mythos Gates visual language. Goal: Authentic mythology + original Mythos Gates universe — NOT copying historical artwork.

7. DIVINE PRESENCE
Every god/goddess must look supernatural. Divinity visible through: divine eyes, supernatural aura, glowing markings, divine crowns, sacred symbols, floating relics, ethereal fabrics, divine particles, energy surrounding weapons, spectral manifestations, elemental manifestations, reality distortion, dimensional energy, Mythos Gate influence. Each deity needs a UNIQUE Divine Signature — do NOT give every god the same glow/aura/effect.

8. DIVINE POWER MUST COME FROM LORE
Do NOT give every character generic fantasy magic. Powers from: Mythology + Divine Domain + Realm + Faction + Personality + Gate Lore. Powers should visually communicate who they are. A god of oceans should not get generic blue magic — power must reflect the actual mythological and realm-based meaning within their lore.

9. SIGNATURE WEAPONS & ARTIFACTS
Every god/goddess has a recognizable divine weapon, artifact, or both. Design answers: Why does this god possess this weapon? Influenced by: mythology, divine domain, realm, faction, combat style, personal history, Gate influence. Must feel like a legendary artifact with history. Avoid generic swords/axes/spears/staffs/bows unless design gives unique mythological identity.

10. GOD/GODDESS PHYSICAL DESIGN
Male gods: Powerful athletic physiques, muscular heroic proportions, broad shoulders, strong silhouettes, divine presence.
Female goddesses: Feminine silhouettes, athletic/curvaceous heroic proportions, elegant proportions, powerful posture, divine beauty.
Both: Powerful + Divine + Beautiful + Legendary. NOT generic bodybuilders, NOT generic anime, NOT ordinary humans.

11. ART STYLE
Stylized-realistic, cinematic, highly detailed 3D mythological fantasy. High-quality 3D forms, detailed facial features, strong anatomy, premium materials, detailed armor/clothing, realistic material behavior, cinematic lighting, controlled stylization, strong silhouettes, high-quality hair, detailed weapons, controlled divine effects. Premium mobile RPG with AAA-quality aspirations.
AVOID: Flat 2D sprites, cheap mobile aesthetics, generic anime, cartoonish proportions, photorealistic humans, generic fantasy armor, sci-fi designs, alien aesthetics, excessive visual noise.

12. MYTHOS GATES INFLUENCE
The Gates are a defining concept. Every realm and deity has a meaningful Gate relationship. Determine from Codex whether Gates are: sacred, feared, worshipped, controlled, studied, corrupted, mysterious, ancient, reality-altering. Reflect that relationship in the character. Do NOT simply put a portal behind every character. The Gates should feel like a fundamental force within the universe — woven into the deity's existence, not decoration.

13. UNIQUE SILHOUETTES
Every god/goddess recognizable at a distance. Silhouette influenced by: headpiece, hair, weapon, armor, clothing, body shape, cape/robes, divine effects, artifacts. If two gods could be mistaken for each other when viewed as silhouettes, redesign one.

14. 3D MODEL REQUIREMENTS
Every concept suitable as foundation for complete 3D game model. Must make sense from: front, back, left, right, gameplay camera, cinematic camera. Consider: armor construction, clothing construction, weapon attachment, hair, accessories, materials, animation, facial expressions, ability effects. Do NOT create designs that only look good from one cinematic angle.

15. COMBAT READABILITY
Gods must remain recognizable during gameplay: fighting multiple enemies, moving through dungeons, fighting bosses, performing abilities, taking damage, moving through realms, viewed from gameplay camera. Face, weapon, silhouette, divine markings, armor, headpiece, signature effect must remain visually identifiable.

16. CHARACTER ART PROMPT FORMULA
For every god/goddess, construct the final art prompt using:
[GOD/GODDESS NAME] — Actual legendary deity of [FACTION], originating from [REALM]. Divine domain: [DOMAIN]. Mythological identity: [MYTHOLOGY]. Personality: [PERSONALITY]. Realm influence: [REALM DESIGN LANGUAGE]. Faction influence: [FACTION DESIGN LANGUAGE]. Wearing [DIVINE ARMOR/CLOTHING] constructed from [MATERIALS]. Signature weapon: [WEAPON]. Divine artifact: [ARTIFACT]. Divine symbols: [SYMBOLS]. Mythos Gate connection: [GATE INFLUENCE]. Divine power manifestation: [POWER EFFECT]. Unique silhouette: [SILHOUETTE]. Facial identity: [FACE]. Hair/headpiece: [DESIGN]. Combat identity: [COMBAT STYLE]. Signature divine effect: [UNIQUE EFFECT].
Premium stylized-realistic 3D mythological fantasy character, cinematic presentation, highly detailed materials, powerful heroic anatomy, distinctive silhouette, authentic mythological inspiration, realm-specific visual identity, faction-specific design language, supernatural divine presence, dimensional Mythos Gate influence, premium AAA-quality game character concept, designed for a high-quality mobile tactical/dungeon RPG.

17. NEGATIVE DESIGN RULES
NEVER generate: Generic fantasy warriors, knights, superheroes, RPG heroes, mortal-looking characters, alien-looking characters, sci-fi characters, guns, firearms, spaceships, modern military, futuristic armor, cyberpunk, steampunk, unrelated mythology, character clones, recolored templates, identical armor, flat sprites, cheap mobile characters, generic anime, random magical effects, realm-inappropriate designs, faction-inappropriate designs.
World built around: Gods + Mythology + Divine Powers + Melee + Magic + Legendary Artifacts + Extradimensional Mythos Gates.

18. REALM + CHARACTER + BATTLEFIELD UNITY
GOD + REALM + FACTION + BATTLEFIELD + MAGIC + ARCHITECTURE + ENEMIES should visually tell the same story. Applies to: campaign environments, dungeon environments, boss arenas, realm hubs, story sequences, character screens, codex, menus, victory screens, cinematics.

19. INTERNAL ART BIBLE
Maintain standards for: Gods/Goddesses (divine character identity), Realms (environmental/cultural identity), Factions (civilization-specific visual language), Enemies (creature and enemy design language), Battlefields (realm-specific environments), Weapons (divine artifact standards), Gates (dimensional visual language), UI (world-consistent interface aesthetics). Prevents visual drift as the game grows.

20. ONE GOD/GODDESS AT A TIME
Do NOT generate the entire roster simultaneously. Work on one deity at a time.
Workflow: 1. Read Codex entry. 2. Identify mythology. 3. Identify divine domain. 4. Identify faction. 5. Identify realm. 6. Identify personality. 7. Identify combat identity. 8. Identify weapons/artifacts. 9. Identify Gate relationship. 10. Build Divine Identity. 11. Build Realm/Faction visual DNA. 12. Generate detailed art prompt. 13. Generate 3D character concept. 14. Run quality-control. 15. Revise until design meets standard. 16. Present finished design for approval. 17. ONLY after approval move to next god/goddess. Do NOT automatically move forward.

21. FINAL DIVINE QUALITY TEST
Before considering a god/goddess finished:
GOD — Unmistakably the correct deity?
MYTHOLOGY — Mythological identity recognizable?
PERSONALITY — Personality felt from design?
FACTION — Faction identifiable?
REALM — Could belong to this realm?
DIVINITY — Genuinely supernatural?
POWER — Power reflects actual lore?
WEAPON — Weapon feels legendary?
GATE — Mythos Gates influence felt?
SILHOUETTE — Recognizable from distance?
3D — Can become complete premium 3D model?
COMBAT — Readable during gameplay?
STYLE — Matches Mythos Gates: Ascension visual identity?
ORIGINALITY — Unique deity, not generic RPG character?
If any major category fails: REVISE THE DESIGN. Do not settle for "good enough."

FINAL CREATIVE STANDARD:
Every playable character should make the player think:
"That's a GOD." → "I know exactly which god that is." → "I know what realm they come from." → "I know what faction they represent." → "I can see how the Mythos Gates are connected to their existence."

Every god should feel ancient.
Every goddess should feel divine.
Every faction should feel like a civilization.
Every realm should feel like a real world.
Every Gate should feel like it connects worlds that were never meant to be connected.
And every character should look like they belong in Mythos Gates: Ascension.
